title: 403 error from web follower API
body: I'm getting this 403 error for the past day (17hrs), unable to get readings using the web follower API. I am on the stable 2025.09.05 build.

comments.body:
Same issue here. I'm assuming it's on the dev end since our last reading times match up.

For the record, Libre Link is working on still and I've even updated the credentials for the associated Libre Link account. Also updated to latest release. Still no readings. Something must have broken.

Same issue for me as well.
